table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	ServiceInvCode, 
	CustCode, 
	OriginalDate, 
	Date, 
	DueDate, 
	HeaderNo,
	HeaderInvNo,
	InvTotal, 
	OutStandingAmt,
	SalesmanCode, 
	ServiceCatCode, 
	Remarks,
	DoctCode, 
	Ref1, 
	Ref2, 
	PatientCode, 
	TokenNo, 
	GuestCode, 
	StudentCode, 
	Marked, 
	ServiceInvTypeCode, 
	MessageCode, 
	LockerCode, 
	MotorVehicleCode, 
	FullPatientName,
	PatientAge, 
	PatientSex, 
	PatientRefBy, 
	SurgeryCode,
	SurgeryProcedureCode,
	EyeVisionCode, 
	IOLPowerCode, 
	DiseaseCode, 
	Mobile, 
	Item
FROM 	ServiceHeader
WHERE 
	ServiceHeader.custcode = CASE :ai_all WHEN 0 THEN :al_custcode ELSE ServiceHeader.custcode END AND
	ServiceHeader.originaldate BETWEEN :ad_sdate AND :ad_edate
